commands.command: focused user deletion store and HTTP tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: Only the authenticated current account can resolve me or its exact numeric ID for deletion.
Session CSRF is required and cross-account deletion returns 404 before storage.
A sole organization owner is rejected with 409 and retains the account.
Deleting an ordinary member removes the user, sessions, memberships, team memberships, verified emails and OIDC identities atomically.
Concurrent deletion of two owners commits one deletion and rejects the other, retaining one owner.
The deleted account cannot reuse its old session or log in again.
